about: Topic backlog for the daily blog writer (scripts/blog/WRITER.md). The writer takes the first topic with status 'todo', researches what ranks now, writes the post, and sets status to 'done' with the slug and date. Keep at least 10 'todo' topics; add new ones at the end with the same fields. Volumes are from our Sep 2026 keyword research (memory keyword-research) where known, otherwise null: never invent one. Competitor URLs are what ranked when the topic was added (5 Nov 2026); re-check them at write time.
rules: Mix: three equal niches (e-commerce & D2C, local business & clinics, real estate). Queue order is ecommerce, local, ecommerce, local, real-estate, repeated; keep that order when adding topics.
Every topic has an industry (ecommerce, local-business or real-estate). The post.json of the finished post must carry the same value.
No invented numbers, results, clients or testimonials. Every figure needs a cited source in the post.
Never name the founder. Author is the Veloxis Global team.
No prices for our own services anywhere.

topics.question: How should a builder or broker in India choose and set up a real estate CRM?
topics.gaps: Top results are vendor rankings that put their own product first. Missing: a neutral checklist, the exact fields and stages to track, how leads flow from Meta/portals/WhatsApp into the CRM, and DPDP consent.

topics.question: What should a local business fix on its Google Business Profile to show up in the map results?
topics.gaps: Most checklists skip Google's own rules (business name, service-area businesses, categories, review incentives) and quote unsourced ranking stats. Ours cites Google's help pages for every rule.
